CHAPTER 17.21
ADMINISTRATIVE COST
RECOVERY PROVISION ACT
(Acts 7 of 1994, 12 of 1994, 11 of 2007 and 9 of 2011)
AN ACT TO PROVIDE FOR THE RECOVERY OF ADMINISTRATIVE COST OR
EXPENSES IN RESPECT OF CERTAIN MATTERS AND FOR MATTERS CONNECTED
THEREWITH OR INCIDENTAL THERETO.
Commencement
[17 June 1994]
Short title
1. This Act may be cited as the Administrative Cost Recovery Provision
Act.
Collection or recovery of administrative expenses
2. There shall be collected or recovered administrative cost incurred or to
be incurred in respect of the several matters set out in Column 1 of the
Schedule to this Act at the rate specified in Column 2 by the persons specified
in the corresponding entry in Column 3 of the Schedule thereto and paid to the
Consolidated Fund.

Price to be marked for all publications
3. (1) Every publication of the Government intended for sale shall be
marked with the price on the cover of such publication and all proceeds of sale
properly accounted for and receipt issued for all sales.
(2) It shall be the duty of all Heads of Departments to ensure that all
proceeds of sales are regularly paid to the Accountant General to be credited to
the Consolidated Fund.
(3) The price shall be determined by the Head of Department in
consultation with the Accountant General having regard to the cost incurred in
printing.
(Substituted by Act 12 of 1994)
Governor acting on the advice of Cabinet may amend the Schedule by
Order
4. The Governor acting on the advice of Cabinet may by Order amend the
schedule to section 2 but no such order shall have effect unless approved by
Resolution of the Legislative Assembly.
(Inserted by Act 12 of 1994 and amended by Act 9 of 2011)
Interpretation
5. In this Act unless the context otherwise requires the expression
“Administrative Cost” shall include “printing cost”.
(Inserted by Act 12 of 1994)
